system.description: The Piper carries a magical flute that grants him the below talents. He can use each once per encounter. If a humanoid creature bears the flute for [[/r 2d6]] days, that person becomes The Piper. Ratsplosion: Summon a loyal swarm of rats (Shadowdark RPG pg. 245). If common folk are nearby, up to [[/r 2d6]] of them melt down into these rats. Dissolve Into Rats: If The Piper goes below 10 HP, he explodes into a swarm of rats and flees. The one albino rat in the swarm is The Piper.
